newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 3.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Political parties start manoeouvring ahead of partial legislative elections in three central Ivory Coast districts where voting was put off last year because of political violence.
- Ivorian cocoa sold at 700 CFA francs per kilo in neighbouring Guinea. The official farmgate price in Ivory Coast is 320 CFA.

- More than 70 enterprises from nine Chinese provinces to exhibit at exposition of Chinese goods in Abidjan from December 12-18. Expo organised by Chinese Ministry of External Commerce and Economic Cooperation.
- New monthly billing system introduced by Ivorian state telephone company CI-TELCOM sparks complaints from customers and causes delays and bottlenecks at paying counters.
